name: Question 9
problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ 15-8x=-4y \\ -y+20x=3z\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}9x+3y-z=16 \\ -8x+4y+0z=-15 \\ 20x-y-3z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 \\ 20 & -1 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}9 & 3 & -1 & 16 \\ -8 & 4 & 0 & -15 \\ 20 & -1 & -3 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Question 9
?

What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

{9x+3y−z=1615−8x=−4y−y+20x=3z

a
[9−3−116−840−1520−130]
b
[9−3116−840−1520−1−30]
c
[9−3−116−8415020−1−30]
d
[93−116−840−1520−1−30]
e
[9−3−116−840−1520−103]
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered x,y,z on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

{9x+3y−z=16−8x+4y+0z=−1520x−y−3z=0

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

[93−1−84020−1−3]

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: [93−116−840−1520−1−30]
